info.name: Landing Page
info.desc: Static marketing site for Rezynt with resume upload entrypoint and analytics instrumentation.

feature.folder_structure: /landing ├── index.html # Main page markup with uploader logic and analytics bootstrap ├── styles.css # Static styling for all sections ├── script.js # Scroll/CTA animations (not bundled today) ├── privacy-policy.html # Legal page ├── terms-of-service.html # Legal page ├── public/ # Static assets served via Vite ├── vite.config.js # Build config with placeholder replacement └── spec.xml # This file

tool.name: PostHog
tool.config: Key injected into index.html through VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY.

tool.name: Google Analytics 4
tool.desc: Mirrors main app settings for cross-domain tracking
tool.config: Measurement ID injected via VITE_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID (falls back to ga_disabled when absent).

tool.name: Google Ads Tag
tool.desc: Global site tag for conversion tracking (AW-17448398300).
tool.config: Static snippet embedded in index.html; conversions fired via gtag_report_conversion on resume upload + CTA clicks (send_to AW-17448398300/ReoSCPu6ncAbENzbhYBB).

script.name: resume_upload
script.desc: Inline factory handles drag-and-drop + click uploads, sends POST to /api/v1/resume/temp-upload, redirects to https://app.rezynt.com/onboarding/?temp_file_id=.
script.success_tracking: Triggers PostHog event landing_resume_uploaded with file_id and Google Ads conversion (AW-17448398300/ReoSCPu6ncAbENzbhYBB) before redirect.

script.name: cta_conversion
script.desc: Hero Build-from-scratch link and footer Start Building button call gtag_report_conversion before navigating to https://app.rezynt.com/start.

script.name: interactions
script.desc: Optional scroll/CTA animations and helper effects (smooth scroll, hover states).

var.name: VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY
var.use: PostHog analytics key injected into index.html.

var.name: VITE_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID
var.use: GA4 measurement ID used by inline bootstrap (index.html).

config.entry: index.html (served by Vite) with static assets from /public.
config.placeholders: Vite plugin replace-landing-placeholders swaps analytics tokens during build/dev.
